runs.answer: The Padres and Gavin Sheets agreed on 20 November 2026 to a three-year, $11MM extension (reported by Robert Murray of FanSided/MLB.com's Mark Feinsand; club not confirmed). The structure is a $500K signing bonus plus a $2.5MM salary in 2027, followed by $4MM player options for both 2028 and 2029 — which works out to an average annual value of roughly $3.67MM ($11MM ÷ 3), a figure MLBTR notes is an artificially low luxury-tax hit. On length, it's three years "in name only": because 2028 and 2029 are player options/opt-outs, only 2027 is truly guaranteed (~$2.5MM salary plus the bonus), and Sheets can test free agency after the 2027 season (or again after 2028) rather than being locked into San Diego through 2029.
